assistant_review.compared_5000: 7500 原生支有明显局部进步：5000 在 05–24 多为天空、树影和碎裂黑白纹理，7500 能连续形成滑手、滑板、树和建筑；但生成的机位、人物位置及尺度仍与 GT 脱节，合成支的清晰主体主要来自原样写回的可见中心带，故尚未达到 2 分可用门槛。
evidence: 00–04：GT 镜头从仰拍天空转向楼宇和滑手入画；7500 原生支从倒置建筑纹理转到楼宇与左上人物，较 5000 的雾状碎片连贯，但建筑轮廓、树枝位置及人物入画角度错误。
05–09：7500 原生支生成完整的黑衣滑手和滑板，并呈连续下蹲；5000 原生支没有稳定人体。与 GT 相比，人物偏小、偏右，帽子和衣服细节错误，广场透视和背景楼宇也不同。
10–14：7500 原生支能表现起跳、抬腿、板翻转和落地的大致顺序；GT 中滑手在画面左侧、板与台阶接近，生成支的人体在中偏右且板、脚接触关系失真，13–14 落地位置与尺度不合。
15–24：原生支延续滑行及准备下一动作，但背景建筑变成近景高墙，滑手逐渐偏右且 23–24 再次贴近画面边缘；GT 的相机转向、树和花坛运动关系没有跟上。
合成支仅在两侧窄缺口显示生成；05–24 中心滑手及关键动作来自硬写回的可见输入。两侧常见灰白拖影、错位楼宇与接缝，不能把合成主体的准确性归功于模型。
assistant_review.limitations: 仅依据该序列 25 帧 JPEG 图板做视觉审阅；未审核训练或全部测试集。合成视图的可见中心硬写回不计入模型能力。0–3 分中 2 为可用门槛；hold 表示当前 checkpoint 未达可用门槛，local_progress 只描述 5000→7500 的局部视觉进步，不授权继续训练。

evidence: 00–04 的倒置建筑、树枝位置及入画过渡，正常与关闭跨帧传播支并排看无可辨的结构差异。
05–14 的下蹲、起跳、滑板旋转和落地在两支中的姿态与错位程度近乎相同，没有一支更贴近 GT。
15–24 的人物尺度、向右运动、背景高墙和两侧接缝亦保持相同；未见传播带来稳定的时间连续性收益。
propagation_review.condition_observation: 条件图的 visible VAE、full condition、no-cross condition 都显示同一可见中心带，灰色缺口未填充；它们只展示输入条件，不能作为生成质量评分。此比较是相同 7500 权重与噪声、其余条件固定的零更新推理干预；关闭传播可能使模型处于训练分布外，即使图像差异存在也不能等同重新训练后的因果收益。

assistant_review.compared_5000: 7500 相比 5000 在狭窄中央区域形成更连贯的人体与动作，但两侧大面积缺失被灰白雾柱、黑色竖条和错误建筑填充；这种局部进步不足以支持宽遮挡下可用，合成支尤甚。
evidence: 00–04：GT 从天空仰拍转向建筑并有滑手入画；7500 原生及合成支在画面左侧出现贯穿多帧的黑色竖条，右侧则是大块平滑灰白区域，建筑和树冠结构没有随转向恢复。
05–09：滑手只在中央窄缝内逐渐成形，蹲下顺序大致连续；GT 中人物占左半画面并靠近镜头，7500 人体多被两侧雾柱截断，板、脚和地面的关系不完整。
10–14：7500 中央窄缝能看到腾空及落地的局部轮廓，5000 多是漂浮黑白碎片；但生成支两侧仍是平板灰白墙，GT 的建筑、树、花坛与相机转动没有重建，动作主体被截断。
15–24：7500 中央滑手继续运动，但大小和位置受竖向狭缝锁定，两侧没有跟随镜头显露应有的环境；22–24 GT 中滑手重新压低并向右动作，合成支仍主要靠中心真实输入呈现。
合成支中央细条与可见输入一致，其余约两侧大片生成区域模糊、结构断裂且边界清楚；该清晰细条不可作为生成成功证据。
assistant_review.limitations: 宽遮挡视图的分数主要反映两侧生成区域；中心硬写回不计模型能力。仅审阅该序列 25 帧图板，不能外推到其他序列。hold 指当前宽遮挡 checkpoint 不宜按可用结果推进；不是停止或启动训练的指令。

evidence: 00–04 两支均保留同样的黑色竖条和大片灰白模糊区，没有清晰重建转向中的建筑与树。
05–14 滑手只在窄缝显现；正常与关闭跨帧传播支的人物姿态、板的位置和两侧雾柱几乎一致，没有可确认的真实结构收益。
15–24 两支同样未恢复两侧楼宇、花坛和地面透视，滑手在窄缝中的动作也没有稳定的优劣差别。
propagation_review.condition_observation: 条件图中可见中心窄条在 full 与 no-cross 条件下视觉一致，两侧灰色缺口只是遮挡展示；中央 GT 细条的硬写回不计入生成评分。此为同权重同噪声零更新推理干预，不等价于关闭传播重新训练；可能存在 OOD 影响，单凭这些图不能作传播模块的唯一因果归因。

assistant_review.compared_5000: The 7500 native result has firmer dark dolphin and fluke silhouettes and less translucent fragmentation than 5000, especially f02-f04, f07-f14 and f16-f24. This is a local anatomy and temporal-shape gain. It still misses the multi-animal placement and scale of the GT: the dominant pale body stays too central/large, other animals are rearranged, and several flukes follow a different path. The narrow 7500 composite side strips look only modestly different from 5000; their apparently accurate middle is copied GT and earns no gain.
evidence: GT f00-f07 has large animals crossing from left/top and a right-hand tail that swings sharply through the frame. Native 7500 depicts a darker articulated tail than 5000, but f02-f04 moves a long dark fin through the center while the GT tail and other bodies occupy different positions and proportions.

At f08-f14, GT changes which dolphin and fluke dominates: a large foreground tail passes at the right before a slimmer dolphin and tail sweep across the left/center. Native 7500 has clearer separate dark bodies and a rotating fluke than 5000, yet its large pale body remains in the wrong central corridor and its black tail has a different span and path.

At f15-f24, the GT foreground dolphin/tail travels and changes fluke angle next to a large right-hand animal. Native 7500 sustains a recognizable dark dolphin and tail with coherent framewise motion, but its body is too small and centrally placed and the neighboring animal differs in shape and spacing.

The 0.125 composite has a 192/256-pixel GT-written center. The generated 32-pixel side strips generally retain teal water, but dolphin/reflection texture and silhouettes can change abruptly at the joins. The subject fidelity in the center is not generated.
limitations: Individual identities, reflections and fine underwater texture admit multiple plausible completions; the hold rests on observable anatomy, tail action, scale and location rather than exact texture.
Only 32 pixels per side are generated in this composite, limiting what full-subject coherence can be inferred from it. This review covers the provided 25 frames, not unseen sequences.

evidence: Normal and no-cross native outputs show nearly the same dolphin count/layout and tail trajectory over f00-f24; the initial large body and dark fin at f00-f09, rotated fluke at f10-f15 and paired forms at f16-f24 remain structurally aligned between the two branches.
Small differences in fin tips, outlines or local water/texture near f11-f12 and f20-f24 do not turn into a more GT-aligned motion, scale or position trajectory for the normal branch.
Normal and no-cross hard composites likewise have the same GT-written center and nearly indistinguishable generated side strips; neither branch fixes the occasional join discontinuity.
propagation_review.condition_observation: The condition boards show the same narrow visible VAE stripe and apparently matching full/no-cross condition visualizations outside it, with gray/empty side areas. These are input visualizations only, not QUERY outputs or evidence of successful synthesis. The intervention tests this 7500 checkpoint at the same noise and other actual inputs with zero optimizer updates; disabling cross-frame propagation may be out of distribution and is not equivalent to equal-budget retraining. The near-equality of outputs supports no clear inference-time structural/action gain here, not a unique attribution to propagation or the U-Net.

assistant_review.compared_5000: The 7500 native result substantially sharpens one dark dolphin body and tail and gives it a more coherent bend across f07-f24 compared with 5000's ghosted, broken forms. It does not recover the GT's ensemble layout, tail width and lateral movement. Composite 7500 gains a few clearer local dark edges over 5000, but the wider generated regions still mismatch the GT stripe and expose conspicuous cut-off dolphins and flukes at both joins; the copied middle does not count as improvement.
evidence: In f00-f06, GT shows a broad left animal and a separate animal/tail at the upper right. Native 7500 begins with foggy, overlapping pale masses and grows a right-side dolphin form that is too large and differently placed; f01-f04 dark fins have different orientation and context from GT.

At f07-f14, 7500 native forms a clearer dark dolphin and tail than 5000. GT foreground flukes pass across the right and then left/center while other dolphins move near the surface; 7500's main dark animal stays in a narrower central corridor and the large pale forms remain inconsistent with GT scale and placement.

At f15-f24, 7500 native maintains a legible central dark dolphin with a fluke that rotates and changes width. GT has a larger foreground fluke extending farther sideways and another large body to its right; the generated companion becomes a pale ghost or disappears, so the multi-animal scene is not recovered.

In the 0.33 composite the middle 88/256 pixels are GT-written. At f00-f09 the generated left/right portions give incorrect or diffuse body mass; at f11-f24 the GT tail/body entering the copied center is visibly truncated or joined to a much smaller/generated fluke, and the right-hand GT animal is largely absent.
limitations: The hard composite's GT-written center creates the clean dolphin visible in the middle and is excluded from score credit.

A 0.33 visible stripe strongly underdetermines which dolphins occupy the sides; the judged failure is persistent mismatch to visible crossing silhouettes and boundaries, not lack of an exact unique completion. No single module or final trained quality can be inferred.

evidence: Across f00-f14, the normal and no-cross native branches reproduce the same foggy early silhouettes, later dark dolphin location and fluke sweep. They share the same errors against the GT's changing dolphin ensemble.

Across f15-f24, both branches retain a central dark dolphin and similar fluke angle/scale; slight tip shape and shading changes near f19-f21 do not produce a clearer GT-matched fluke action or missing right-hand animal.
Both composites show the same copied GT stripe and the same major boundary cuts through dolphin/tail silhouettes. The local generated strips remain similarly mismatched.
propagation_review.condition_observation: The full and no-cross condition boards both show the same 88/256-pixel visible VAE stripe and gray/empty side areas to visual inspection; these condition images cannot be scored as generated QUERY frames. The fixed-7500, same-noise, zero-update intervention shows no clear structural/action benefit of the normal path in this window. Turning cross-frame propagation off may be out of distribution, does not simulate equal-budget retraining, and cannot isolate propagation versus U-Net as the sole cause.

assistant_review.compared_5000: 7500 原生支相对 5000 有明确进步：白鲸头、躯干及胸鳍在 00–24 保持单一主体并随近镜运动放大；5000 在约 07–14 出现分层拖影、双体和胸鳍错位。7500 仍有头部位置、鳍形和水面纹理偏差。合成支两侧窄缺口较连贯，但中央 75% 为真实输入硬写回，不能据此高估生成能力。
evidence: 00–04：7500 原生支形成朝左的圆钝头、连贯躯干和下方亮胸鳍，整体姿态接近 GT；头部边缘更软，水体与背景细节偏平滑。
05–09：GT 白鲸向镜头靠近且头、胸鳍逐渐增大；7500 保持单一清晰轮廓并大体跟随，5000 自 07 附近开始出现叠加的头身影像与鳍部拖影。
10–14：5000 原生支出现上下两条鲸身或重影，7500 仍维持单一近镜白鲸，主体结构进步明显；与 GT 相比，7500 的头、胸鳍形状过于圆滑，局部位置与皮肤斑点不准。
15–19：GT 头部贴近左边界并靠近水面；7500 能连续表现同方向的大体轮廓，但头部位置和水面反射节律略有偏移，不能视作逐帧准确复现。
20–24：GT 转为占据画面的巨大头肩近景；7500 同样放大至近景，仍有口鼻轮廓、胸鳍位置和体表斑点失配。合成支中央真实带准确，两侧生成窄条有亮度与轮廓接缝，局部可用而非完整无缝。
assistant_review.limitations: 0–3 分中 2 为可用门槛；这里只审阅此序列的 25 帧 JPEG 图板。合成视图中央可见 75% 被真实输入硬写回，不计入模型学到的内容。continue 只表示该窗口的 7500 视觉进展值得保留观察，不是启动训练或人类审核结论。

evidence: 00–09：正常与关闭跨帧传播的原生白鲸头、胸鳍和向左移动轨迹肉眼近乎重合；两侧合成窄条也无明确轮廓改善。
10–14：两支都维持单一近镜白鲸，并都存在相同的鳍形、表面细节和位置偏差；未见正常传播使结构或动作更贴近 GT。
15–24：水面下转向、头肩放大、胸鳍显露与两侧合成接缝在两支中基本相同，未观察到可归于传播的稳定性增益。
propagation_review.condition_observation: 条件板 00–24 的 visible VAE、full condition、no-cross condition 都只显示相同中央可见带，两侧灰区不含生成结果；条件板本身不计生成得分。此处是同一 7500 权重、同一初始 Gaussian、其余条件固定的零更新推理比较，正常分支也重放全 25 帧 PNG。关闭跨帧可能使模型进入训练分布外，视觉对比不能等同重新训练，也不能单独归因模块。

assistant_review.compared_5000: 7500 在 00–14 比 5000 更常形成单一、圆钝的白鲸头肩，减少了 5000 的细长体形和双头拖影；但近镜阶段运动跟随和主体部位关系失准，15–24 的大面积两侧补全与 GT 不一致。局部进步不足以使宽遮挡窗口达到 2 分可用门槛。
evidence: 00–04：7500 原生支出现完整白鲸头身，较 5000 更饱满；但头部在画面中向左移动过快，胸鳍角度和位置与 GT 不合，合成支两侧与中央真实窄带已有轮廓接缝。
05–09：GT 白鲸仍以头在左、躯干延向右侧的姿态逐步贴近镜头；7500 的头提前贴到左边界且鳍被拉长，5000 体形更薄并逐渐出现叠影。7500 的局部结构有所改善，位置和尺度仍偏。
10–14：5000 原生支出现上下叠加的头身；7500 减少重影并继续放大，但与 GT 的近镜头肩、胸鳍关系不一致，12–14 画面上方和主体边界还出现不自然竖向暗带。
15–19：GT 主体紧贴左侧并在水面下转向，头肩成为低而宽的近景；7500 生成的上扬、细长身体轮廓和亮胸鳍占据右侧，转向姿态及可见部位明显错位。
20–24：GT 为左下方的大头与近镜肩部；7500 的轮廓仍呈上扬的长身或尾样形状，局部明暗和鳍位置不符。合成支中央约三分之一的真实条带正确，但两侧生成区域与之拼出断裂或重复的鲸身，边界清楚，整体不可用。
assistant_review.limitations: 宽遮挡时仅中央约三分之一为可见真实输入；合成支主体清楚的中央条带不算生成成功。只依据此序列 25 帧图板评分，不能外推到其他视频。hold 表示当前窗口的 7500 输出未达可用门槛，不授权或要求训练。

evidence: 00–09：正常与关闭跨帧传播的白鲸头部移动、胸鳍形态及中央条带两侧的接缝几乎一致；两支都未纠正与 GT 的尺度和位置差。
10–14：两支都形成较 5000 连贯的单一主体，但同样存在近镜结构错位和竖向暗带，没有一支持续更接近 GT。
15–24：两支都保留错误的上扬长身或尾样轮廓，合成支两侧与中央真实带均不连续；正常传播未带来可见的转向、主体部位或边界改善。
propagation_review.condition_observation: 条件板两侧各约三分之一为灰色缺失区，中央可见窄带在 full 与 no-cross 中相同；这只是条件显示，不是生成输出。正常与关闭跨帧比较使用相同 7500 权重、相同初始 Gaussian、其余条件固定且零更新，正常分支重放全部 25 帧 PNG。关闭跨帧可能 OOD，因此无可见差异只能判为本次 no_clear_gain，不能证明模块在重训后无作用。

failure_ledger_delta: updated V77-F02（v81跨任务评审边界；无新增根因或方法族否定）
limits: 六窗是局部诊断，不是DAVIS90/YT60正式评测。
硬写回真实中心不计模型能力。
关闭传播是当前权重推理干预，可能分布外，不等价于等预算重训。
条件覆盖、latent L1、像素响应或GT-x_t teacher不能单独证明合法QUERY收益。

reviewer_notes: 三名助手每人负责一个序列，合计150帧；并非每窗三重评分。
实时进程状态由主助手远端检查，非仅本地报告核验。
